title: Generic 'show me the menu' falls back to the first multi-page menu-image page when the single menu_image_url field is unset
notes: A business with no business.menu_image_url but with business_menu_images pages adopted (Mochachos Westville's real plan: Regular Menu Page 1/2 + Secret Creations) must still get an image on a plain, unnamed 'show me the menu' request -- the first page in sort order -- not silently nothing. Never sends every page at once ('avoid unnecessary image messages').
